findings.citation: Document this gap in the module.
findings.description: No verifier clause inspects the required module documentation.
The behavioral probes load the modules but perform no strict TypeScript or `any` check.

findings.citation: Sibling modules may be imported only with `import type`; at runtime only Node built-ins are available (the modules run under Node 24 with built-in type stripping).
findings.description: Module loading can expose some invalid runtime imports, but no clause enforces the syntactic import-type-only rule.
